newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat settles lower on soybean input.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat settles lower on soybean input.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures settled lower after being pressured by spillover weakness from CBOT soybeans, traders said.
Soybeans opened sharply lower Friday amid news Taiwan had passed on several tenders overnight.

MGE traders said buying by local traders helped the May/July spring wheat spread rebound Friday after having been wracked by commercial-oriented selling Thursday. The spread widened 3-1/4 cents to settle Friday at 13-3/4 cents on paper.
"During most of the morning, the spread was offered at 11-1/2 or 12 cents. Later in the session, people wanted to buy it at 12 cents," a trader said.
The trader said locals, sensing that commercial support had reappeared in the spread, bid up the spread late in the session.
MGE spring wheat settled five to 8-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with May down 5-1/4 cents at $4.06-1/4. September lost eight cents to settle at $3.92.
MGE barley futures did not trade.
